 Breaking: Bayern Munich boss Vincent Kompany taken to hospital after collapse
 FC Bayern had a scare today with head coach Vincent Kompany.
 by CSmith1919 Updated Oct 23, 2026, 3:35 PM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 (Photo by Leonhard Simon/Getty Images) Getty Images Part Of SC Freiburg vs. Bayern Munich: 2026/27 Bundesliga full coverage see all updates CSmith1919 Chuck Smith is the site manager for Bavarian Football Works, where he began writing in 2017. He is the author of The Daily Schmankerl, the longest-running daily Bayern Munich column in English, and also writes The Weekend Warm-Up. In addition to covering Bayern Munich news and providing commentary on Bayern Munich, the Bundesliga, and the German national team. He brings more than 30 years of sports-writing experience to the site. Over the course of his career, he has written for numerous newspapers and websites. Concern is growing around Bayern Munich head coach Vincent Kompany after Bild reported that the Belgian manager was taken to a hospital in Munich by ambulance on Friday.
 According to the report, a helicopter had landed earlier at Bayern’s training ground on Säbener Straße. Further details about the circumstances surrounding the incident have not yet been confirmed. This is the exact wording posted by @iMiaSanMia ):
 ❕ Vincent Kompany was taken to a Munich hospital by ambulance today. A helicopter had landed at the training ground on Säbener Straße earlier. More info shortly.
 Sky Germany (via @ iMiaSanMia ) is reporting that Kompany collapsed at training;
 Vincent Kompany collapsed after today’s training session. The coach was immediately taken to a hospital by ambulance. A rescue helicopter had landed at the training ground earlier.
 Kompany had been battling a severe illness (reported to be a viral infection) and a hip issue ahead of Bayern Munich’s Champions League game against Arsenal, but he was cleared to return to the bench. Bayern Munich is now preparing for Sunday’s Bundesliga clash against SC Freiburg following Wednesday’s 2-2 draw with Arsenal in the Champions League.
 The most important thing is Kompany’s health and well-being. Understandably, Bayern Munich supporters are hoping that the situation is not serious and that the 40-year-old coach is receiving the care he needs.
 There is no confirmed information yet regarding the reason for his hospitalization or whether it will affect his availability for Sunday’s match. Further updates are expected as more details emerge.
